title: VariantChanged
description: A variant was created or changed (including deactivation). Full state, not a diff: consumers upsert by variantId. Keyed by productId.

options.description: Variant options sorted by name, e.g. color=Black and size=M. A list, not a map, so an empty set stays a JSON array through the outbox.

active.description: False once the variant can no longer be sold.
